lines.text: #tr.en: All these are the ziqpu stars in the path of the stars of Enlil which stand in the middle of the sky
#tr.en: opposite your breast, and by means of which you observe
#tr.en: the risings and settings of the stars at night.
$ single ruling
#tr.en: If you are to observe the ziqpu, you stand
#tr.en: in the morning before sunrise, West to your right,
#tr.en: East to your left, your face directed towards South;
#tr.en: on the 20th of Nisannu the kumaru of the Panther in the middle of the sky
#tr.en: opposite your breast, and the Crook rises.
$ single ruling

lines.atf: disz ina _{iti}gu4 u4 1(disz)-kam gaba_ sza _{mul}u4-ka-du8-a_ ina _murub4 an_-e

lines.text: #tr.en: On the 1st of Ajjaru, the Breast of the Panther stands in the middle of the sky
#tr.en: oppostie your breast, and the Stars rise.
$ single ruling
#tr.en: On the 20th of Ajjaru, the Knee of the Panther
#tr.en: stands in the middle of the sky opposite your breast, and the Jaw of the Bull rises.
$ single ruling

lines.atf: disz ina _{iti}sig4 u4 1(u)-kam_ a-si-du sza2 _{mul}u4-ka-du8-a_ ina _murub4 an_-e

lines.text: #tr.en: On the 10th of Simanu the Heel of the Panther stands in the middle of the sky
#tr.en: opposite your breast, and the Shepherd of Anu rises.
$ single ruling

lines.atf: disz ina _{iti}szu u4 1(u) 5(disz)-kam mul_ ne2-bu-u2 sza2 _{mul}szu-gi_ ina _murub4 an_-e _min min {mul}kak-si-sa2 kur_-ha

lines.text: #tr.en: On the 15th of Du'uzu the bright star of the Old Man (stand in the middle of the sky opposite your breast, and the Arrow rises.
$ single ruling
22-23. disz ina _{iti}NE u4 1(u) 5(disz)-kam mul-mesz_ um-mu-lu-tu4 sza2 _{mul}szu-gi _min min {mul}ban kur_-ha
#tr.en: On the 15th of Abu the dusky stars of the Old Man tand in the middle of the sky opposite your breast, and the Bow riseen:
$ single ruling

lines.atf: disz ina _{iti}kin u4 1(u) 5(disz)-kam {mul}masz-tab-ba-gal-gal min min {mul}SZU-PA u {mul}eridu{ki} kur-mesz_-ni

lines.text: #tr.en: On the 15th of Ululu the Great Twins stand in the middle of the sky opposite your breast, and ŠU-PA and the Star of Eridu rise.
$ single ruling
#tr.en: On the 15th of Tešritu the Lion stands in the middle of the sky opposite your breast, and the Scales rise,
$ single ruling

lines.atf: disz ina _{iti}apin u4 1(u) 5(disz)-kam {mul}e4-ru6_ ina _murub4 an_-e min min {mul}ud5 kur_-ha

lines.text: #tr.en: On the 15th of Araḫsamnu Eru stands in the middle of the sky oppoite your breast, and the She-Goat rises.
$ single ruling
#tr.en: On the 15th of Kislimu ŠU-PA stands in the middle of the sky opposite your breast, and the Panther rises.
$ single ruling
#tr.en: On the 15th of Tebetu the Standing Gods stand in the middle of the sky opposite your breast and the Swallow rises.
$ single ruling
#tr.en: On the 15th of Šabatu the Dog stands in the middle of the sky opposite your breast, and the Field rises.
$ single ruling
#tr.en: On the 15th of Addaru the She-Goat stands in the middle of the sky opposite your breast, and the Fish rises.
#tr.en: The gods who stand in the path of the Moon, through whose regions the Moon in the course of a month
#tr.en: passes and whom he touches:
$ single ruling
#tr.en: The Stars, the Bull of Heaven, the True Shepherd of Anu, the Old Man,
#tr.en: the Crook, the Great Twins, the Crab, the Lion,
#tr.en: the Furrow, the Scales, the Scorpion, Pabilsag,
#tr.en: the Goat-Fish, the Great One, the Tails, the Swallow,
#tr.en: Anunitu, and the Hired Man,
$ single ruling
#tr.en: All these are the gods who stand in the path of the Moon, through whose regions the Moon in the course of a month
$ single ruling
#tr.en: passes and whom he touches.
$ single ruling
#tr.en: [...] travels. Tablet 1 of MUL.APIN.
#tr.en: [... According] to its original written and checked.
